messages.content: Hey! Weekly check from Northline Care. How are you doing?
Good. Quick question though - bread really messes with my blood sugar. What else should I be eating?
That's a great question, but I'm not able to give diet advice. I can escalate you to a nurse who can help with that though?
Done. A nurse will contact you about your bread alternatives and diet. Median wait time is 31 hours. Any readings or meds to log today?

theme: diet question, what to eat instead of bread
